data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 288.884m. During 2024 there was a small adverse movement in prior year estimates (gross +GBP 0.199m), representing a very minor strengthening of reserves (c.0.07% of opening reserves). The movement is recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation as "Change in estimates of prior year provisions 199 (1,328) (1,129)". The wider claims environment in 2024 was dominated by weather catastrophes (notably Hurricane Helene and Milton) although the Syndicate reports it outperformed its catastrophe budget; claims inflation has been allowed for within best estimate reserves (overall impact GBP 2.7m net). No material per-line reserve movements are disclosed.

An explicit impact for claims inflation has been included within the best estimate reserves, in line with SCOR Group scenarios and Lloyd's guidelines.
The overall impact across all lines of business for all underwriting years is GBP 2.7m net (2023: GBP 3.8m) on an earned basis.
